**Auction**: The team treats his contract as a 'work experience' program.

Subodh Pawar.description:
Subodh is a flair player who looks like a million bucks right before getting out for ten. He's a highlight-reel specialist with a very short reel.

**Batting**: Ranked #8 in batting average - the man simply refuses to go back to the pavilion.

**Bowling**: Ranked #5 from the bottom in economy - he provides runs with the generosity of a charity foundation. Ranked #6 from the bottom in bowling average - his wickets cost more than a luxury vacation.

**Fielding**: He treats the ball like it's contagious.

**Auction**: He's a 'steal', in the sense that he's stealing a spot on the roster.

Sunil S.description:
Sunil is the glue of the batting order, mostly because he's so hard to get out once he's stuck. He's a marquee player with a marquee attitude.

**Batting**: Ranked #4 in total runs - basically the league's primary tax collector. Ranked #5 in 4s - the boundary ropes have restraining orders against him. Ranked #9 in batting average - the man simply refuses to go back to the pavilion.

**Bowling**: Ranked #9 from the bottom in economy - he provides runs with the generosity of a charity foundation. Ranked #2 from the bottom in bowling average - his wickets cost more than a luxury vacation.

**Fielding**: Ranked #10 in total dismissals - the ball just naturally gravitates to his 'sticky' hands.

**Auction**: Ranked #5 in auction price - he's the league's equivalent of a luxury tax. Ranked #5 from the bottom in Value Index - his price-to-performance ratio makes the team owners weep.

Tapish Sharma.description:
Tapish is a bundle of nerves and excitement who bowls like he's being chased by a bear. He's a bargain buy that occasionally hits the jackpot.

**Batting**: Ranked #7 from the bottom in runs - keeping the scorers' pens fresh and ink-filled. Ranked #7 from the bottom in average - his visits to the crease are shorter than a TikTok video.

**Bowling**: Ranked #2 from the bottom in economy - he provides runs with the generosity of a charity foundation. Ranked #8 from the bottom in bowling average - his wickets cost more than a luxury vacation.

**Fielding**: His fielding is the reason the bowlers have gray hair.

**Auction**: Ranked #2 from the bottom in price - an absolute steal, like finding a diamond in a thrift shop.

Tharun.description:
Tharun is a man of mystery who exists only in the rosters and our imagination. He's the ultimate 'NA' in a world of stats.

**Batting**: His bat is basically a decorative piece of wood he carries around for the aesthetic.

**Bowling**: The only 'stumps' he sees are the ones he's walking back to after his over.

**Fielding**: He's the reason we have a 'Deep' position - to keep him far away.

**Auction**: Ranked #1 from the bottom in price - an absolute steal, like finding a diamond in a thrift shop.

Tushar Pritam Naik.description:
Tushar is a hard-hitting batter who views every ball as a personal challenge to his authority. He's a value player who hits it further than his price suggest.

**Batting**: The only thing he's hitting is the showers early.

**Bowling**: Ranked #1 from the bottom in economy - he provides runs with the generosity of a charity foundation.

**Fielding**: His fielding is just an elaborate way to avoid playing the game.

**Auction**: His auction price is a mystery that even Sherlock Holmes couldn't solve.

Uday Pratap Singh.description:
Uday is a pace merchant who believes that if the ball isn't whistling, it's not fast enough. He's a wicket-taking machine with a very high maintenance cost.

**Batting**: His bat is so clean you could eat off it.

**Bowling**: Ranked #5 in wickets - the middle stump is his favorite souvenir. Ranked #4 in economy - tighter than a billionaire's wallet.

**Fielding**: His arm is so slow the ball has its own birthday before reaching the keeper.

**Auction**: His price was determined by a random number generator.

Vaibhav Ganatra.description:
Vaibhav is a focused blocker who believes that if you don't play a shot, you can't get out. He's a tactical genius of the defensive arts.

**Batting**: His highest score is usually the temperature of the ground in Celsius.

**Bowling**: Ranked #4 from the bottom in economy - he provides runs with the generosity of a charity foundation.

**Fielding**: His fielding is the reason the team needs a backup keeper for the backup keeper.

**Auction**: He's a 'surprise' package that everyone wants to send back.

Vinay Dewan.description:
Vinay is a spiritual leader whose tactical insights are as valuable as they are rare. He plays for the love of the game, and the love of the post-match drinks.

**Batting**: He treats the boundary ropes like they're made of lava.

**Bowling**: He's the only bowler who needs a GPS to find the stumps.

**Fielding**: His sliding stops are actually just him tripping over his own feet.

**Auction**: His price-to-performance ratio is a dividing-by-zero error.

Vinay Veliyat.description:
Vinay is a utility man who is always in the right place, mostly by accident. He's a versatile player who fills the gaps that nobody knew existed.

**Batting**: His batting grip is the only thing tighter than the runs he scores.

**Bowling**: His bowling plan is 'please don't hit me too hard'.

**Fielding**: He's a 'magnet' for the ball, if that magnet also had the same polarity as the ball.

**Auction**: He's a 'long-term' investment that's currently in the 'no-returns' phase.
